1. What the Repository Content Is — and What It Is Not

The Repository Content is a collection, made available free of charge, of blueprints, showcases, tools, templates and other Items that illustrate what could potentially be built with Revizto, including on top of the Model Context Protocol (“MCP”), using project data and files. Depending on the Item, you may be able to interact with live project data drawn from your Revizto workspace, convert or otherwise process files, and generate analytics, summaries, visualisations and other outputs.

The Repository Content is provided purely as a head start and source of inspiration to help Revizto Customers and other users explore and create their own solutions. It is not a finished, supported or production-ready offering. It is not a “beta,” “preview,” “pilot” or “early access” program in any contractual sense, and no expectation of any kind should be inferred from those or similar labels.
